pitch: Everyone picks a character for someone else. You see their cards, never yours. Work out who you are with yes-or-no questions.

createRoom.visibilityHint: Public rooms show up on the home screen. Private ones only take people with the link or the code.
createRoom.seatsHint: The match can start with 2 players or more.

createRoom.themesHint: Everyone votes: before each match, 3 themes from the sets you turn on go to a quick vote. I type it: you write the theme when the match starts.
createRoom.needOneSet: Turn on at least one set.
createRoom.hostNote: When the match starts, you write any theme you like, with a few ideas at hand. If 30 s go by, everyone votes instead.
